name: agent-risk-layer
description: Evidence-based AI-agent security platform with local inspection and controlled adversarial red-team testing.

scripts.check: node --check server.js && for f in src/*.js public/*.js inspector/*.mjs redteam/*.mjs public/downloads/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
scripts.validate: npm run build:release-assets && npm test && npm run check && npm run smoke
scripts.build:release-assets: npm run build:inspector-release && npm run build:redteam-release && npm run build:sample-report
scripts.redteam:simulation: node redteam/agent-risk-redteam.mjs run --authorised --environment test --profile hardened --out data/local-redteam.json
scripts.pretest: npm run build:inspector-release && npm run build:redteam-release
